help.title: Help
help.question: How can we help?
help.oneMinute: Short answer · tap the speaker to listen

register.title: How to register a farmer
register.text: Tap “Register a farmer”, read the consent to the farmer, then ask each question. Tap the speaker to play a question in their language. Everything is saved on this device as you go.

noNetwork.title: What to do with no network
noNetwork.text: Keep working. Farmers and visits are saved on this device and sent automatically when the network comes back. You can also open Sync and tap “Sync now”.

fixRed.title: How to fix a farmer marked red
fixRed.text: Red means the server could not accept the details. Open the farmer, read the red message, tap Edit and correct it. It is sent again automatically.

myDetails.title: How to check my details
myDetails.text: Your extension officer registered you with MoFA. To change your phone number, farm or crops, ask your officer at the next visit.

whoToCall.title: Who to call
whoToCall.text: Your extension officer is your first contact for advice and changes to your details.

install.title: Install the app
install.short: Opens faster and works without network
install.heading: Put AgroConnect on your home screen
install.why: It opens like an app, works without network, and uses less data.
install.android2: Tap Install again when your phone asks.
install.open: Open AgroConnect from your home screen.
install.iphone1: In Safari, tap the Share button.
install.iphone2: Tap “Add to Home Screen”, then Add.
install.notOffered: Your browser has not offered installing yet. Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.done: AgroConnect is installed on this device.

advice.good_to_spray: A good day to weed or spray: no heavy rain expected.
advice.rain_soon_dont_spray: Rain is coming. Don't spray today or tomorrow, the rain will wash it off.
advice.dry_spell_water: A dry week. Water young plants early in the morning and cover the soil.
advice.storm_protect_harvest: A storm is coming. Bring in or cover any harvest drying outside.

cropCheck.title: Check my crop
cropCheck.guide: This is a first guide. Show your officer if you are not sure.
cropCheck.chooseSymptom: Choose at least one thing you see.

advice.check_under_leaves: Look under the leaves and inside the funnel for caterpillars, early in the morning.
advice.pick_and_crush: Pick and crush the caterpillars and egg groups you find.
advice.ask_officer_spray: Ask your officer which spray to use and how much.
advice.remove_sick_leaves: Remove the sick leaves or plants and burn or bury them away from the farm.
advice.add_fertiliser: Add fertiliser or compost around the plants.
advice.water_early: Water early in the morning or late in the evening.
advice.mulch_soil: Cover the soil with dry grass to keep it wet.
advice.improve_drainage: Make channels so water does not stand around the plants.
advice.show_officer: Show the plant to your officer at the next visit, or call them.

cropCheck.photo: Photo of the leaf (if you can)
cropCheck.photoHint: Hold the sick leaf in good light. The photo stays on your phone.

harvest.title: Harvest forecast
harvest.intro: What your farm could give this season, from its size and crops.
harvest.none: Your officer has not recorded your crops yet.
harvest.worthNote: At today's price in {{market}}. Prices change; selling together often pays more.
harvest.wrong: Something wrong? Ask your officer to update your farm.

tips.storage: Dry and store the grain well
tips.check: See a sick plant? Check my crop

harvest.passed: Harvested in {{month}}; next season's comes after planting

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.intro: Short lessons you can listen to, even without network once heard.

dry-grain-storage.title: Keep your grain dry
dry-grain-storage.summary: Dry grain well before storing, use clean bags on pallets, and check every week for insects.

fall-armyworm-signs.title: Spot fall armyworm early
fall-armyworm-signs.summary: Look for ragged holes and sawdust-like droppings in young maize leaves. Act in the first week.

maize-spacing.title: Plant maize at the right spacing
maize-spacing.summary: 75 cm between rows and 25 cm between plants gives more cobs from the same land.

compost-at-home.title: Make compost at home
compost-at-home.summary: Mix crop waste, animal dung and ash in a heap, keep it damp, and turn it every two weeks.

selling-together.title: Sell together, earn more
selling-together.summary: Farmers who sell through their cooperative get better prices and pay less to transport.

mobile-money-safety.title: Keep your mobile money safe
mobile-money-safety.summary: Never share your PIN, and check the name before you confirm a payment.

alerts.title: SMS alerts
alerts.intro: Choose what we send you by SMS. Each SMS is short and in your language.
alerts.drySpellHint: When no rain is expected for 7 days
alerts.free: Alerts are free for you. Reply STOP to any SMS to turn them off.
alerts.noPhone: Your record has no phone number, so SMS cannot reach you. Ask your officer to add it.
